leadText: Daniel J. Edwards is an American actor who worked on the English-language dub of from Pokémon the Series: XY to Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. He is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.
plainText:
Daniel J. Edwards is an American actor who worked on the English-language dub of from Pokémon the Series: XY to Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. He is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Edwards was born on June 21, 1988. As an adult, he became a voice actor and was involved with a number of English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. Edwards joined the during , but his best-known role was as Aether Foundation Branch Chief during .
